Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Controls maturity matrix & evidence sampling for ISO/FedRAMP intake — Acme Financial

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the intake form. We completed a preliminary review and have a couple of focused asks to make the upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping call more efficient:  

1) Can you share a controls maturity matrix that maps each control to an owner, current maturity level (Initial / Managed / Defined / Quantitatively Managed / Optimizing), and any compensating controls?
2) We want a short inventory snapshot (CSV) of available evidence types per control (e.g., logs, policy docs, PKI attestations) and the last available date for each evidence item. If feasible, include sample locations (Drive links or S3 prefixes).
3) Proposed 30-minute walkthrough next week — can someone from your compliance or security team run through the matrix and call out any high-risk or out-of-scope controls ahead of the audit?

If possible please provide the matrix and inventory by EOD Monday (2026-08-17); that will allow our audit team to select representative samples before the on-site window.

Thanks,

Renee Harper
Senior Intake Auditor
Audits R Us
[audit@auditsrus.com]

--

Thanks — I reviewed the v0.3 matrix this morning and pushed a few security clarifications. High-level:  
- Detection & Response controls: maturity mapped to 'Defined' for core coverage; we have centralized logs for infra and app stacks but retention varies (30–365 days depending on retention class). I annotated columns with the longest available retention and the default retention.
- PKI / Key management: Rishi will confirm which key policies are covered by KMS vs HSM and supply attestation artifacts.
- Compensating controls: noted for legacy admin processes where automation is incomplete; these have compensating monitoring in place.

I've uploaded a read-only folder and a short agenda for the walkthrough. Proposed slot on Tue 2026-08-18 10:00 AM PT works for our team. I'll run the technical portion and Kim can cover policy/mapping.

Thanks for the quick follow-ups and the uploads. Confirming: 10:00 AM PT Tue 2026-08-18 for a 30-min walkthrough is good. A couple of clarifying items before the call:  

- For sampling, we may request logs covering the period 2026-06-01 through 2026-07-31 for a subset of detection controls — please confirm availability for that window (we saw notes about 30–365 days retention).
- If possible please attach the S3 prefixes or Drive links next to the inventory rows for traces we might request; makes our selection much faster.
